name: Dhaka District Police — SP office and thanas
attribution: Office of the Superintendent of Police, Dhaka (police.dhaka.gov.bd), the thana portals and the Dhaka DC portal
notes: No licence stated. police.dhaka.gov.bd publishes no thana list or contact table; SP office from the Superintendent's officer card (+ address from 'যোগাযোগ'), thanas from the 5 upazila thana portals' officer cards (office landline, OC's police official mobile, *.gov.bd e-mail). Personal e-mails, other mobiles and officers' names are not copied. The DC portal gives 7 thanas in the upazila area; Ashulia and South Keraniganj thana portals (police.ashulia.dhaka.gov.bd, police.southkeraniganj.dhaka.gov.bd) failed TLS verification and are not included.
